summary: CWE-209: the bad() entry point called exceptUnsupportedOperation.printStackTrace(), which writes the full stack trace to standard error where it can be exposed to users, leaking internal implementation details. I replaced the printStackTrace() call with controlled server-side logging through the existing IO.logger, which records a generic message plus the exception for operators without surfacing the trace to callers. The exception-handling feature is preserved. I added the java.util.logging.Level import needed for the log call.

edits.new: IO.logger.log(Level.WARNING, "Caught UnsupportedOperationException while performing operation", exceptUnsupportedOperation);
